result:
I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s2.json`. Riley got 3 correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Note |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | correct | The model writes a request and the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | wrong (M6) | Riley chose to let the agent keep running. It needs a stopping condition such as a step limit. |
| q4 | partial (M4) | The count of 4 is right, but the reasoning says the model "runs" the tools. The program runs them. |
| q5 | correct | Both parts were there: the result goes back as the next input, and the model uses it to decide its next step. |
| q6 | partial | The name is only part of it. The model chooses from the whole description: name, purpose and parameters. |

**Summary:** Riley has the shape of the loop down, and recalled it from memory four days later. Two things need fixing. First, the model never runs a tool. Second, an agent needs a stopping condition.

**Next step:** Take the makerspace assistant's loop and mark where each tool is run and what ends the loop. Then write a three-line description for `check_calendar`: its purpose, its parameters, and when not to use it.

I also added learning record `0003-who-runs-tools-and-when-to-stop.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. Submission s1 has not been graded yet.
